summary: Prevent one repetitive source from filling every evidence slot in cross-source project questions.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content
A synthetic comparison returned eight specification passages and omitted all RFI, Submittal and Email sources
Ordinary non-comparison questions must retain relevance-first behavior
approval_evidence: The active improvement goal explicitly covers project efficiency, accuracy and RFI/Submittal/Email adaptability.
known_limitations: Source-family inference is deterministic from file names, exact workflow headers and evidence locators; it does not establish contractual authority.
Diversity can only select evidence that matches the question terms and deterministic source markers; it does not infer an unstated relationship.
Validation uses synthetic offline evidence and does not establish construction accuracy on customer documents.
